introPt: A traveller edits a dish on the menu instead of describing a new one.

dialogo.pt: Of course, no onion. Anything else?

dialogo.es: Il formaggio è già dentro. Le faccio un altro primo?
dialogo.pt: The cheese is already in it. Shall I do you a different first course?

perguntas.pergunta: How do you order still water?
perguntas.explica: Naturale works too; frizzante and con gas are sparkling.

perguntas.pergunta: The waiter says è già dentro. What does that mean?
opcoes: The ingredient is cooked into the base, so senza is not possible
perguntas.explica: The substitution they offer next is the useful part.

perguntas.pergunta: Which word adds instead of removing?
perguntas.explica: Più asks for more of what is already there.

perguntas.pergunta: Does senza change shape depending on what follows?
perguntas.explica: That is why it carries more of the module than any other frame.

perguntas.pergunta: Which situation does senza NOT cover on its own?
perguntas.explica: An allergy needs an unambiguous sentence, not a polite subtraction.
